calls.answer: I'll search for information on this.**Official process:** Citadel's campus page says there are four steps in the process, and that a 45-minute interview covers both technical and behavioral skills, with a focus on coding, data structures and algorithms and problem-solving. You meet people from both Citadel and Citadel Securities, and the process is the same for both firms. Team fit isn't assessed in the first and second rounds. The page excerpt I saw did not spell out all four steps. **Anecdotes (Glassdoor/Taro, anonymous):** - One new grad described an online assessment, then a technical phone screen, then a 3-hour onsite. - A recent report described a HackerRank first round with two coding problems and ten multiple-choice questions on topics like caching. - Another new grad was asked standard LeetCode problems plus follow-ups on low-level OS optimizations. - Intern reports (a related pipeline, not new grad) mention a superday of three back-to-back 45-minute technicals. Reviewers' experiences vary, and one noted that interview content can vary greatly depending on the interviewer.
